ctx.x: Except I think maybe years ago with the singers, people like Roland Hays. Did you ever hear that name? A very dignified man and successful. Paul Robeson, Marian Anderson ...

Even the man that man that was with Anton Dvořák, that was in Ohio; great singer*---that was Anton Dvorak who wrote the New World Symphony. [Ed. note- Harry T. Burleigh, one of Dvorak's students, was born in Erie, Pennsylvania].
